text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Haa, ngh...!!
Haa, haa, haa—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (—My mind is set.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I trained this hard with the real race in mind.
And today, I got real race experience too...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I see it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
My job.
My speed.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: The form... that I must master is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, in the waiting room.
Believe spoke quietly, yet with firm resolve.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Endurance.
That is the craft I wish to hone.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Fastest is best."
...Grandpa used to say that too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to become fast.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Faster, faster.
—I'll run all the way through, keeping this top speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on everything we've been through—
I, too, become certain. That truly seems to be
the path meant for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Believe runs in what is called a 'Pace' style. She's well-suited for a strategy of positioning near the front of the pack to control the overall pace of the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, the pace Believe sets is fast.
Fast enough to deny the other Umamusume any chance to conserve their stamina.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Believe simply won't slow down!
She holds on relentlessly until the very last stride,
refusing to let front-runners get away or closers pass her by—
choice_data_list: (That right there is her strength, her speed...!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I want to accomplish it.
My job, through this form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While nodding in firm agreement, I continue.
In short, what she's trying to do
is maintain a continuous "dash state"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just the other Umamusume who were naturally
worn down by the high pace.
Believe herself was significantly exhausted as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Of course, it's a strategy she can only choose because she possesses the mental fortitude to endure it. But from here on, mental strength alone won't be enough—
choice_data_list: We'll have to build a body that can endure that form, too.
We'll need to build a body that can handle that form, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I never thought it would be a form one could master easily.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No matter the technique, no matter the run.
First—solidify the basics.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(It's precisely because of a foundation built solid, strong,
and without a single flaw.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (A realm that could be called the absolute pinnacle is within reach.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...And so.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Please let me focus on conditioning my body.
For a while—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No.
At least for the remainder of the Junior Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, it was quite a drastic decision.
Feeling the weight of it, I somehow manage to nod.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While she might gain practical race experience when the opportunity arises,
her focus would mainly be on training—
for half a year. ...Or perhaps even longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still, Believe made a fair point, and I agreed with her. In that case, there was nothing to do but move forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we agreed not to set any specific target races for at least the remainder of the Junior Year...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after the Winning Live concluded smoothly,
just as we were about to leave Kyoto Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Belieeeeeeve!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Right O-san?
Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I will explain everything now.
But before that, once more."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Belieeeeeeve!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, what a truly straightforward call.
The long dash part is especially sublime. My vocal cords are delighted."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The one who spoke about her unique worldview right after arriving was Calstone Light O. She's a classmate and peer of Believe's, frequently crossing paths with her.
choice_data_list: Um, did they come to cheer for me...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That's right, let me explain everything.
First off, Kyoto felt pretty far honestly,
so I planned on watching it at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: However, seeing Believe standing in the paddock changed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
In short, I just wanted to talk to you.
I wanted to talk so, so badly that I couldn't stand it.
So I had no choice but to start running!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So I hopped straight onto the Shinkansen.
Naturally, I rode in the lead car since it reaches Kyoto the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And I ran all the way from Kyoto Station.
It's over 10 km, so
I almost passed out more than 10 times, but—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The roads were mostly straight, so I managed just fine.
As expected of the ancient capital Kyoto, it's the best.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I was running and missed both the race
and the Winning Live, so I want you to run
and then dance for me later.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that's why I'm here.
Believe. I wanted to tell you as fast as possible.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, convey—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Run with me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Run. Let's run. An immediate race is best.
Let's run at top speed!"
choice_data_list: L-Light O, calm down a little—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I can't calm down. If I could, do you think
I would've blasted my way from Tokyo all the way to Kyoto?!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Believe, you are fast.
Faster with each passing day.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Today's race must have been truly, truly fast as well.
Though I couldn't watch it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why. Run, with me.
—In the realm of utmost speed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O rattles on with overwhelming momentum. It's completely her pace.
Just as I start to feel overwhelmed—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I won't run. Not yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...With complete indifference, keeping an unwavering tone,
Believe answered just like that.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Not yet? Does that mean not today?
Tomorrow is fine, then."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No, not tomorrow either—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kh, next week then, is it?
It cannot be helped.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No,
it is not next week either, Light O-san.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What, then next month!?
No, or maybe—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It's next year.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...Next year?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...Once more.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Next year or later, please.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...Next year and beyond.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Believe's strengths shine through even here.
Withstanding Calstone Light O's fierce assault,
Believe steadily makes her presence known."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: For the rest of the Junior Class, I will dedicate myself entirely to training.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
So, I won't decide on a target race.
If you want a guarantee of competition,
please wait until next year or later.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Calstone Light O, in an exceedingly rare
moment, stood in silent thought for several
seconds before—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Then how about next year's Falcon Stakes in March?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...A 1,400m race, is it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'd like to narrow our focus to 1200m races for my workplace, but—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No, we can't wait any longer.
The Falcon Stakes. You have to settle it here.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Close it out, Believe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
May I?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Looks like Believe gave in this time. 'Momentum' and 'patience'—their weapons may differ, but their stubbornness is identical. A well-matched relationship, perhaps."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, though it was quite a ways off... our target race was set on the Falcon Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on the Shinkansen ride home,
which Calstone Light O ended up boarding as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing that Believe had dozed off in her seat from exhaustion, I quietly slipped away to handle some business without waking her, but—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Are you really serious about all this?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Usually, one would set at least one goal race
in the Junior class. Otherwise, you won't be
able to build up a proper track record.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "And yet, are you telling me you intend to put that aside and spend the Junior Class focused on training?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Got it.
Then one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Focusing only on 1200m races"—is she serious about that too?
If so--

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"The earliest GⅠ race you can enter
is the Sprinters Stakes, held in the fall
of the Classic year."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Never. Not once.
Even knowing that, you still intend to restrict yourself solely to 1200m races?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see. Never mind, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O answers briskly and heads
back to her seat. Meanwhile, I find myself
unable to move from the spot for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...I already knew this would happen. Junior Class achievements become secondary, and available GⅠ races will be extremely limited."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The weight of the decision I felt in the waiting room
came bearing down heavily upon my shoulders once again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was this truly... the right choice?
As if trying to shake off the doubts welling up inside,
I simply gazed out the train window at the scenery rushing by—
